requirements.statement: Saturating arithmetic execution composes ARM condition evaluation with valid decode and emits the selected result write and sticky-Q set request only when the instruction executes; it emits no NZCV write.

source_refs.locator: §A3.2 Condition field; §A4.1.46 QADD; §A4.1.50 QDADD; §A4.1.51 QDSUB; §A4.1.52 QSUB

requirements.statement: The ARM9TDMI profile cannot emit a destination or Q-flag write for an ARMv5TE saturating arithmetic encoding, regardless of its condition result or arithmetic operands.
